items.title: ICC prosecutor: No issue with video testimony of witnesses
items.description: The prosecutor of the International Criminal Court does not foresee any issue with the audio-video link setup for some of the witnesses who will testify against former president Rodrigo Duterte.

items.title: No guarantee of zero blackouts amid El Niño – DOE chief
items.description: The Department of Energy cannot guarantee that Filipinos will be spared from blackouts as a “very strong” El Niño threatens to strain the country’s power supply amid rising temperatures.

items.title: Hontiveros seeks probe into pet crematorium scam
items.description: Sen. Risa Hontiveros has filed a resolution seeking a Senate investigation into the unregulated commercial pet service industry following the discovery of dozens of dead pets abandoned in a vacant lot in San Jose del Monte, Bulacan.

items.title: Expect P16.80/liter gas price cut today

items.title: Macalintal to challenge SC ruling on BSKE postponement
items.description: Election lawyer Romulo Macalintal will ask the Supreme Court to review its decision upholding the constitutionality of the law that fixed a five-year term for barangay and Sangguniang Kabataan officials and postponed the BSK elections to 2028.

items.title: Marcos swears in Zalameda, stresses speedy justice
items.description: President Marcos yesterday emphasized the importance of an independent judiciary and speedy disposition of justice as he administered the oath of newly appointed Chief Justice Rodil Zalameda.

items.title: PNP gets over 500 tips on Bato’s whereabouts
items.description: The Philippine National Police has received and acted on more than 500 tips on the possible whereabouts of wanted Sen. Ronald “Bato” dela Rosa, with police teams conducting searches in various parts of the country, including remote islands, PNP chief Gen. Jose Melencio Nartatez Jr. said yesterday.

items.title: Congressmen: No P1 trillion budget insertions
